summary: OPKO Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing Note Purchase Agreement, issuing $125 million in additional senior secured notes due 2044. The notes bear interest at 3-month SOFR (4.0% floor) plus 7.5% per annum, paid quarterly from EirGen's Pfizer royalty payments, with excess interest covered by Mazdutide payments from Eli Lilly (capped at $187.5M) and then principal. The notes are secured by royalty interests and guaranteed by subsidiaries. This is a debt financing arrangement, not a special situation; no change of control, tender, or strategic event is involved. Watch for covenant compliance and royalty performance.
